The villa

A whole house, only for you.

Elia Country House stands in Ano Alepochori, a peaceful, traditional corner of West Attica where the mountain meets the sea. The house is detached, with a private entrance, and all of it is yours: three levels of living space, a garden full of olive, fig and vine, and a pool that looks out over the countryside.

  • Detached house, 230 m², private entrance
  • Free private parking on site
  • Air conditioning & fireplace
  • Free Wi-Fi in every room
See the five bedrooms

The area

Between the mountain and the Corinthian Gulf.

Ano Alepochori is a quiet, safe, traditional village of West Attica, surrounded by olive groves and pine forest. The beaches of Psatha and Alepochori, known for their clear water and seaside fish tavernas, are a short drive away, and the house is a fine base for day trips to the Corinthian Gulf, Mount Pateras, the Peloponnese and Athens. A car is essential.

Mini markets, bakeries and traditional restaurants are close by; Elefsina and Vilia, with more shops, are about 25–30 minutes away.

How many guests does Elia Country House sleep?

Up to 13. The house has five bedrooms and five bathrooms: two bedrooms with a large double bed and a sofa bed, one with a single bed and a bunk bed, one with a double and one with an extra-large double bed.

Is the pool private and heated?

Yes. The outdoor pool is exclusively for the guests of the house; it is heated and open all year, with a shallow end, sun loungers and a pergola for shade.

Where exactly is the house?

In Ano Alepochori, 190 12, West Attica. It is about 11 kilometres from Alepochori beach, 14 from Megara railway station and 80 from Athens International Airport.

Do I need a car?

Yes, a car is essential for the beaches, the shops and day trips in the area. There is free private parking at the house, with no reservation needed.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 15:00 to 22:00 and check-out from 09:00 to 11:00. Please tell us your arrival time in advance; photo ID is needed on arrival.

Is it suitable for families with children?

Yes, children of every age are welcome. There is a ping-pong table, board games, children’s books, baby safety gates, a children’s room with a bunk bed and a pool with a shallow end. A cot is available on request, subject to availability.

Are pets allowed?

No, pets are not allowed at the house.

Can I host a party or event?

No. Parties, events, and hen or stag parties are not allowed, and quiet hours apply from 14:00 to 17:00. The house is meant for families and groups looking for peace and quiet.

What is near the house?

Mini markets, bakeries and traditional restaurants are close by. The beaches of Psatha and Alepochori, with fish tavernas by the water, are a few minutes’ drive away, and Elefsina and Vilia are about 25–30 minutes away.

How do I book?

Send us your dates and the number of guests by WhatsApp, e-mail or phone on +30 697 201 9513, and we will reply with availability and the price. The house is also listed on Booking.com.
